question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

The brook ________ from an underground spring.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"emanate"** means to come out from a source; to flow out, issue, or proceed, as from a source or origin. (निकलना)

 
 
• **Example: **Light **emanated** from the lamp, filling the room with a warm glow.
 
 
 
• **"Emanates"** refers to the present tense form of the verb** "emanate,"** indicating that something is currently coming out from a source. (प्रसारित होता है)
 
 
• **Example: **The fragrance of jasmine **emanates **from the garden every evening.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Has emanate** (है प्रसारित): This is grammatically incorrect as "has" should be followed by the past participle form of the verb.

 
 
• **Example:** The sentence "The brook has emanate from an underground spring" is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Had emanate** (था प्रसारित): This is also grammatically incorrect as "had" should be followed by the past participle form of the verb.
 
 
• **Example:** The sentence "The brook had emanate from an underground spring" is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Has emanating** (है प्रसारित हो रहा): This is grammatically incorrect as "has" should be followed by the past participle form of the verb.
 
 
• **Example:** The sentence "The brook has emanating from an underground spring" is incorrect.
